'''Zhaoye''' is a male NPC Xuanfang Warden found with his fellow Warden, Cangxian and Jiangban. 

They can be found at Xuanfang Hold, Verdant Court after the completion of {{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}} 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:'''Zhaoye:''' Please let me retire safely and return home to get married.

:'''Cangxian:''' That sounds great. But listen, if I'm not standing there as your best man, I won't forgive you.

:'''Jiangban:''' Hey, don't leave me out! I've been saving my appetite for your wedding feast for ages!

:'''Rover:''' (They say it's bad luck to make promises like that before a battle... but as the saying goes: a single branch is easily snapped, while a bundle remains unyielding.)

:'''Rover:''' (If these three stay together... perhaps they really have nothing to fear.)

:'''Rover:''' (I hope so, anyway...)

{{Dialogue End}}
